correctness.rationale: All centrally symmetric genuine hexagons have the stated affine strip normal form. Six exact polynomial Wachspress weights yield the stated strictly concave quadratic. A positive factored discriminant proves unique center maximum; strict concavity restricts minimum to vertices; explicit vertex values and monotonicity of positive harmonic pairs establish exact sharp ratio. Algebraic deficit identity proves global inequality and iff rigidity; a continuous degenerating family realizes all larger values. A standalone exact-rational checker verified the symbolic identities and affine precision at 210 admissible rational parameter pairs. Finite checks are not substituted for universal analytic proof.

value.rationale: Shape classification of a canonical affine-invariant denominator-range measure addresses an exact geometric stability question arising from Wachspress coordinates. It quantifies all symmetric-hexagon shapes, locates extrema including vertex switching, proves a sharp rigid affine optimum and an exact nonnegative deficit, rather than recomputing the known regular-hexagon ratio. The result does not assert direct numerical conditioning implications.
